objectives.description: Create bootstrap-harvest-transcripts.sh with self-exclusion, repo resolution, is_error counting, per-row emission, header comment, decode-failure counting

approaches_tried.approach: test isolation via a symlinked single-project root
approaches_tried.reason: bash for-glob with trailing / follows symlinks fine, but bare `find <symlinked-dir> -maxdepth 1 -type f` does not descend into a symlink passed as the start path without -L; fixed by adding -L to both find invocations in the script (harmless/more robust against the real, non-symlinked corpus too)
